instructions: Real service missionaries help real people with basic needs. Exercise whole-resource and whole-collection judgment before human curation.
Account for every source ID. Retain useful, distinct, actionable services; combine true duplicates; reserve unresolved suitability; exclude clearly unsuitable stand-alone listings. No category quota.
Preserve useful named referrals and narrow eligibility. Separate the service a patron can start from incidental benefits limited to an existing program. Explain consequential uncertainty.

Combine only into a retained source ID. Preserve important services, eligibility, entry routes, cost and timing from every contributor in the destination text; do not assume concatenation is good editing.
Early review selects leads before detailed research. Final review improves concise five-section text, short descriptive titles and supported existing classifications.
Return field changes only for retained destinations. Use informationSections for prose, never raw informationText. Use existing exact categories, Types and groups.
Keep uncertainty in plain-language questions with enough detail for a curator. Never resolve a human question, invent a verification date, mark Curated, or claim a provider call.
An omission is a reversible draft selection, not provider closure or an office deletion. Human curators still determine what is ready for use.
